posts.author: Cheeseballs
posts.body:
So,firstly,hi,my name's cheeseballs.As a newbie,I've started using RPG Maker MZ to make my dream game,but sadly,I have absolutely no clue on what I'm doing.I've watched a few tutorials here and there,the game I'm planning on making isn't really stylish,but like VERY VERY minimalist and abstract,so,I think it won't require much,but still,I have no idea on what I'm doing.I have a few questions which I'll leave down here,below,and it would be a lot of help if you guys could help me with this.
Questions:
1.What are resolutions?Are they those things that you use to alter the game's display size depending on the screen used?If so,should I worry alot about them?(FYI,My game consists of basic shapes like circles,and squares,etc.,so I'm puzzled)
2.Is it possible to customize the options menu(In the title screen/main menu) of the game?As in,the appearance,sounds,and add or subtract a few settings?
Also,any advice you could give is much welcomed.If you guys know any plugins that like...can customize the options menu(in the title screen of the game,that is),customize the hud,sounds and basically anything,please do give recommendations.
